mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as userCount, SUM(CASE WHEN user_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as guestCount FROM website_visit WHERE visit_date = #{date}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO website_visit (user_id, ip, visit_date, last_visit_time, count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{ip}, #{visitDate}, #{lastVisitTime}, #{count})
mapper.select: SELECT visit_date as date, IFNULL(SUM(count), 0) as pv, COUNT(id) as uv FROM website_visit WHERE visit_date >= #{startDate} AND visit_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY visit_date ORDER BY visit_date ASC
